theme: Rental listing scrapers and datasets (Craigslist, Zillow rentals, Apartments.com, Idealista, Rightmove, Zoopla, Immoscout24, SeLoger, Immobiliare, Domain, realestate.com.au)
queries_run: gh search repos "craigslist rentals dataset" --sort stars
gh search repos "idealista" scraper OR dataset --sort stars
gh search repos "rightmove" scraper OR dataset --sort stars
gh search repos "immoscout24" scraper OR dataset --sort stars
gh search repos "zillow" rental OR rent dataset --sort stars
gh search repos "realestate.com.au" OR domain.com.au OR seloger OR immobiliare scraper OR dataset --sort stars (too generic, drowned out by unrelated top-starred repos)
gh search repos "craigslist" apartment OR housing OR rent scraper --sort stars

candidates.name: idealista18
candidates.what_it_holds: Committed open real-estate-listing dataset scraped from Idealista.com for three major Spanish cities (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia) for the year 2018, published as a companion to a peer-reviewed paper (DOI 10.1177/23998083241242844). Includes for-sale and likely rental listing records with price, location, size fields under ODbL-1.0 licence.
candidates.why_useful: Long-term-rental pricing panel for major EU cities (2018 vintage) is a real, licensed-for-reuse, committed dataset — directly fills gap #13 (LTR data for STR↔LTR crossover / host supply economics) and is old enough to be a useful historical anchor Inside Airbnb itself lacks.
candidates.size_hint: city-level listings dataset, exact row count not confirmed from search metadata; academic paper companion

candidates.name: idealista_data_extraction
candidates.what_it_holds: Repo explicitly states it contains 'both the datasets and the extraction files' for Idealista (API + web scraping, Python). Geography/time span not confirmed without cloning.
candidates.why_useful: A second committed Idealista dataset + method; worth checking depth against idealista18 for a longer or different-city panel.

candidates.name: Scrapy-Idealista
candidates.what_it_holds: Scrapy-based scraper for idealista.com real estate site (sale + rental listings), 185 stars, actively updated Aug 2026, GPL-2.0.
candidates.why_useful: Most-starred, actively maintained Idealista scraper; a working method to pull LTR pricing for Spain if the team ever wants a live long-term-rental comparator series.

candidates.name: Idealista-Immobiliare-Scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Scraper covering both Idealista (Spain/Italy/Portugal) and Immobiliare.it (Italy) for-sale/rental listings.
candidates.why_useful: One of the few repos bridging two of the requested sites (Idealista + Immobiliare); extends the acquisition-method coverage to Italy.

candidates.name: Idealista (Portugal)
candidates.what_it_holds: Web scraping and data analysis of all Idealista listings in Portugal.
candidates.why_useful: Portugal LTR coverage is thinner than Spain in most catalogues; worth a look for a Lisbon/Porto rental panel adjacent to the team's existing Portugal hotel-demand dataset.

candidates.name: rightmove_webscraper.py
candidates.what_it_holds: Widely-used (282 stars) Python class scraping rightmove.co.uk (UK's largest property portal, sales + lettings) into a pandas DataFrame; actively maintained.
candidates.why_useful: Turnkey method for pulling UK long-term-rental/for-sale asking prices by postcode/region — useful as a UK housing-cost comparator or host-economics proxy.

candidates.name: london_rightmove
candidates.what_it_holds: 'Production ML rental prediction system' built on Rightmove London rental listings; likely includes a scraped dataset plus pipeline code.
candidates.why_useful: London-specific rental panel/pipeline; could give a London LTR price series to compare against London STR (Inside Airbnb already covers London).

candidates.name: open-properties
candidates.what_it_holds: CLI/MCP/Skills toolkit to search, deduplicate and monitor listings across 9 property portals in 9 countries (UK, Ireland, US, Canada, Germany, Australia, Spain, Italy, Portugal) — effectively a multi-country Rightmove/Zoopla/Idealista/Immobiliare/etc. client built for AI agents.
candidates.why_useful: Single tool spanning most of the theme's target sites at once (incl. Australia and Germany); could be the fastest path to a standardized multi-country LTR pull if the team ever needs one comparable panel.
candidates.geography: UK, Ireland, US, Canada, Germany, Australia, Spain, Italy, Portugal

candidates.name: ImmoSpider
candidates.what_it_holds: Crawler (215 stars, active Aug 2026) for the Immoscout24.de website, Germany's largest property portal (sale + rental).
candidates.why_useful: Established, actively maintained German rental/property scraper; feeds a Germany LTR proxy.

candidates.name: immoscraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Immoscout24.de scraper plus data analytics/notebooks — likely includes example pulled datasets alongside the scraping code.
candidates.why_useful: Combines acquisition with ready analysis of German rental/sale listings; check notebooks for any committed historical CSV snapshots.

candidates.name: cleaning-RWI-GEO-RED
candidates.what_it_holds: R scripts to clean and construct hedonic price/rent indices from RWI-GEO-RED — the Research Data Center Ruhr's (FDZ Ruhr, RWI Essen) academic microdata product built from ImmoScout24 real-estate listings (sale + rental, apartments and houses) at German district / labor-market-region level, panel back to 2007-2021 in the repo's example config. Raw data itself is restricted-access, obtained directly from FDZ Ruhr (https://www.rwi-essen.de/en/research-advice/further/research-data-center-ruhr-fdz), not committed to the repo; only cleaning/index-construction code is here.
candidates.why_useful: Points to the most rigorous, longest-running (2007+) academic German rental/housing microdata panel available, built from ImmoScout24 — a much longer, quality-adjusted hedonic-rent-index construction than any raw scraper gives, and a genuine academic-replication-package angle. Restricted access (registration/approval needed via FDZ Ruhr), so flagged as a pointer, not an immediate pull.
candidates.size_hint: national German ImmoScout24 microdata panel (millions of listings, per FDZ Ruhr documentation); this repo is code-only
candidates.license: none declared (code); underlying RWI-GEO-RED data is restricted/academic-access

candidates.name: rental_analysis_switzerland_immoscout24
candidates.what_it_holds: Python scripts to download apartment rental listings from immoscout24.ch (Switzerland) and convert to a pandas DataFrame, plus downstream price-prediction modeling.
candidates.why_useful: Swiss LTR rental listing pull method; smaller, niche market but adds a country not otherwise covered.

candidates.name: Rent_Prediction
candidates.what_it_holds: Data retrieval of Swiss rental properties from Immoscout24, with cleaning/analysis and both a regression model and a from-scratch neural network for rent estimation.
candidates.why_useful: Second Swiss Immoscout24 rental pull method; corroborates hamedrazavi repo above for a Switzerland LTR proxy.

candidates.name: zillowdata
candidates.what_it_holds: Committed zip-code-level Zillow datasets including Zip_Zri_MultiFamilyResidenceRental — i.e. a stored extract of the Zillow Rent Index (ZORI/ZRI) at zip-code granularity, monthly, with example series shown for Chicago zips (60606, 60657, 60614).
candidates.why_useful: Zillow's own rent index (ZORI/ZRI) is named explicitly in gap #13 (Zillow ZORI/Redfin/Apartment List/Realtor.com); this repo has an actual committed zip-level extract rather than just a link to Zillow Research, though it is a small/old snapshot repo and Zillow Research's live data page is a better primary source going forward.
candidates.time_coverage: monthly, exact range unconfirmed (repo dated 2020, so likely covers Zillow's ZRI history up to ~2019-2020)
candidates.size_hint: zip-code x month panel, national but repo last touched 2020

candidates.name: Zillow-dataset-samples
candidates.what_it_holds: Sample of 1,000+ Zillow listings extracted via the Bright Data scraping API, committed as a demo dataset (for-sale/for-rent listing attributes, images, prices).
candidates.why_useful: Small demo only (1k rows, marketing sample for a paid scraping service), but confirms Bright Data's Zillow scraper output schema if the team ever wants to replicate a pull.

candidates.name: immo
candidates.what_it_holds: Bot monitoring immoscout24.de and wg-gesucht.de for new German flat listings and auto-applying.
candidates.why_useful: Live-monitoring method covering two German rental portals at once (Immoscout24 + WG-Gesucht); marginal beyond ImmoSpider/immoscraper above, but wg-gesucht adds shared-flat/room-rental coverage not seen elsewhere.

candidates.name: fredy
candidates.what_it_holds: Multi-platform (ImmoScout24, Immowelt, eBay Kleinanzeigen) European apartment/house search-and-notify tool, 1,495 stars, very actively maintained.
candidates.why_useful: Most popular repo found in this theme; a working, well-maintained multi-source German/European rental listing monitor, though built for personal notification rather than dataset export — would need adaptation to accumulate a panel.

notes: Craigslist searches were the weakest: no dataset repos surfaced (only live scrapers, most for jobs/cars/gigs rather than rental housing, and the top-starred ones were generic or unmaintained one-offs) — nothing worth flagging beyond what's listed. A combined OR-query for realestate.com.au/domain.com.au/SeLoger/Immobiliare was too generic and returned unrelated top-starred repos (public-apis, firecrawl, crawl4ai, etc.) rather than housing-specific hits; a dedicated single-term search for each of those sites individually would likely need 3-4 more gh calls than the 6-call budget allowed, and is worth another scout's attention (Australia, France, Italy specifically underexplored here). Rightmove's real BLM/ADF data-feed format repos (stilliard/blmreader, frozensheep/rightmoveADF, mattcannon/Blm, robotmay/blm) were skipped as pure parsers for a proprietary feed format with no committed data. RWI-GEO-RED (via eyayaw's cleaning repo) is the most academically rigorous find but is restricted-access, not a public pull — flagged as pointer only. No repo found gives a ready ADR-style *realized* long-term rental price panel outside Spain (idealista18) and the US (Zillow ZORI extract); most everything else is asking-price scrapers with no committed longitudinal data, which is a real gap worth another scout revisiting with country-by-country single-term searches (Rightmove UK Land Registry mashups, SeLoger France, Immobiliare.it Italy, Domain/realestate.com.au Australia specifically).
